provenance.rejectedDraftHistory: Turn 6 runtime-capture registries and their emitter-derived authority were rejected in audit round 2 and deleted. This embedded artifact was then field-reviewed and reauthored against the approved change artifacts and deterministic test scenarios.

targetMisses: foreign expected token derived from observed OCE
shallow equivalence gate and rejected-key case bug
reporter fixtures enabled unreachable downstream seams
auditRound3.remediationAuthority: Schema 4 exact typed authority, semantic canonical hash, expanded authority/plan/spec/task equivalence, fixture-scoped lifecycle observations, independently supplied foreign tokens, granular fail-fast fixtures, and deny-by-default System.IO IL policy.

targetMisses: required-subset rather than exact schema closure
external equivalence script read C# source and asserted DynamicData text
S16 structural rows carried constant disposition/effect self-certification
auditRound4.remediationAuthority: Schema 5 removes vacuous fields and method-file metadata; runtime deserialization disallows unmapped members; external equivalence enforces exact authority keys while reading only authority/plan/spec/tasks; compiled reflection and IL alone prove method, signature, and DynamicData wiring; S16 structural rows contain only independently observed fallback and guard data.

targetMisses: behavioral verification did not reject fallbackShapes
structural verification left common authority fields unconsumed
auditRound5.remediationAuthority: Behavioral verification requires fallbackShapes to be exactly empty. Structural verification consumes exact metadata, semantics, empty identities, every forbidden flag and retry, empty tokens/edges/seam exceptions, exact cleanup defaults, exact result defaults, all empty behavioral collections, and five exact fallback rows. Runtime and external mutation sentinels prove role violations and representative common-field mutations are rejected.

targetMisses: scenario/task partitions allowed unexplained empty bindings
transitive IL walker enqueued unrelated nested async MoveNext methods
auditRound6.remediationAuthority: All 43 scenarios and 42 tasks fail closed to consumed exact contracts or typed compiled/external proof bindings with verified method/gate clauses. S39 finish rejection consumes an exact behavioral contract. Partition removal mutations fail runtime and external validation. IL traversal follows only each root state machine and recursively referenced test-assembly helpers; neighboring async sentinels prove root isolation.

targetMisses: null returnedResult was falsely reported as a successful result identity match
auditRound7.remediationAuthority: ExecutorEventCorrelation.ResultSame is nullable: null when no result returned, true only for exact ReferenceEquals, and false for a distinct returned instance. Finish rejection retains exact attempted terminal content and original sink exception identity without return, retry, or recursion.
